text:
alice: Starting feature-flag rollout for `model-routing-v2`. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3h in change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Pin canary to v2.1. @dave please ACK config. We'll have deploy-bot monitor and oncall on standby.

deploy-bot: rolling out ff `model-routing-v2` cohorts=[5,25,100] version=v2.1 window=02:00-05:00UTC. Monitoring p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost. Logs: https://dash/reports/rollout/3112223334

ben: suggest adding cost guard — if token-cost per-min jumps >20% trigger hold and alert finance.

carla: agree. also add perf gates: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms, error-rate < 0.5% for 10m window. If any breach -> pause and auto-rollback to v1.9. 

alice: good. here's the control command if we need quick rollback:
```
ffctl rollback model-routing-v2 --to-version v1.9 --reason "perf/regress"
```

dave: ACKed. I'll watch the k8s pod density and GPU util. If GPU util > 85% across canaries hold ramp.

oncall-bot: NOTE: scheduled change window at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Pager if auto-rollback triggers or deploy-bot posts ERROR.

ben: also leaving a note in release notes: "model-routing-v2: improved latencies for short prompts; configurable routing policy". Keep a canary tag to avoid sticky sessions.

alice: starting cohort 1 (5%). Deploy-bot please post status on each step and tag telemetry-slice for cohort.

deploy-bot: COHORT STARTED step=1 size=5% commit=sha@abc123 monitoring=enabled

carla: monitoring looks clean for first 12m. no error spikes. cost +3%.

dave: GPU util 48%. all good.

alice: proceeding to 25% in 20m. will re-evaluate telemetry. :rocket:

deploy-bot: scheduled next step at +20m. Will auto-pause on any gate breach.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if you need manual immediate disable:
`ffctl set model-routing-v2 --state off`

ben: noted. good luck team.

alice: thanks — will post final when 100% done.
